name: Campingplatz Hiasenhof
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Hiasenhof is nestled on the peaceful outskirts of Thiersee in Tyrol's Kaisergebirge range. It provides pitches set within lush alpine meadows with views of the surrounding peaks. Guests can walk to scenic Lake Thiersee in just a few minutes. Facilities include modern sanitary buildings, a fresh bread service, and a barbecue area, appealing to hikers and tranquility-seeking nature lovers.
